description_en: Configures the operations and maintenance (O&M) settings for a user. These settings include the active maintenance window
description_zh: 配置用户的运维信息，目前包括主动运维窗口信息
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-active-operation-maintain-conf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cycle-type Week --cycle-time 1 --maintain-start-time 8:00Z --maintain-end-time 12:00Z --status 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyActiveOperationMaintainConf

parameters.help_en:
The cycle type. Valid values:

Month

Week
parameters.help_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周
parameters.name: cycle_type

parameters.help_en:
The time of the cycle.

If CycleType is set to Month, specify the day of the month. Valid values: 1 to 28. Use commas (,) to separate multiple days.

If CycleType is set to Week, specify the day of the week. Valid values: 1 to 7. Use commas (,) to separate multiple days
parameters.help_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接
parameters.name: cycle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the task. The time must be in UTC and in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the maintenance window. Use the HH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 可维护时间段的结束时间。格式为[unk]hh:mmz-hh:mmz[unk]（utc时间）
parameters.name: maintain_end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the configuration. Valid values: 1 (Enable) and 2 (Disable)
parameters.help_zh: 是否生效 ,1 是 2 否
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
